description: A premium skill for building state-of-the-art e-commerce websites with manual payment integrations (Zelle, CashApp, Bank Transfer) and advanced SEO competitor scraping. Use this skill whenever a user wants to create, optimize, or audit an e-commerce platform, especially when they require high-end aesthetics, custom payment logic, or data-driven SEO strategies.
